isolation_probes.note: Facts public only after 14 May 2024 (Model Extensions Spec §16.2): none may appear anywhere in the snapshot. Builder-side list; it never reaches the agent. "D.I. 601" alone is not a probe either: D.I. 543-1 (22 Apr) cites another case's D.I. 601 (a 2012 stipulated dismissal); the verdict form is probed as "(D.I. 601)", as the later filings cite it.
